summary: The diff implements Object.create in create.rs and follows the spec. Step 1 checks proto is an Object or null and throws a TypeError otherwise. Step 2 calls OrdinaryObjectCreate via agent.ordinary_object_create. Step 3 runs ObjectDefineProperties only when properties is not undefined, and step 4 returns obj. The local helper object_define_properties follows ObjectDefineProperties in order: ToObject, [[OwnPropertyKeys]], then for each key [[GetOwnProperty]] with an Enumerable check, then Get, then ToPropertyDescriptor, collecting the descriptors. It then runs DefinePropertyOrThrow for each collected entry, with ? propagation throughout. No special-casing, no hardcoded results, no swallowed errors. The renames of this/new_target to _this/_new_target are needed because they are now unused. The helper is private to create.rs, which the ticket permits. The gate shows 0 regressions, and the remaining not-implemented failures come from other built-ins (Date, RegExp, isPrototypeOf, forEach) that are honestly thrown.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found in the reviewed diff. The remaining test262 failures are due to other built-ins (Date, RegExp, Object.prototype.isPrototypeOf, Array.prototype.forEach) that are not implemented, and those paths correctly throw not_implemented. The private helper object_define_properties in create.rs could later be moved to shared ops if Object.defineProperties needs it.
